_comment: Pennyroyal Next adaptive MTP widths: pass this file as --speculative-adaptive-config.
Keys are batch-size floors and candidate steps are speculative_num_steps; at topk=1 a
width's draft-token count is steps+1, so C1 may pick W4/W8/W16 (3/7/15) and C>=2 stays
W4. Launch for it: --speculative-num-steps 15 (a candidate wider than the launch width
is refused, not resized under captured graphs) and a BS1 bucket in --cuda-graph-bs-decode
for the W8/W16 states; without BS1 a C1 batch pads up into the C>=2 tier and stays W4.
The C1 tuning keys are the donor public wa configuration (bench/adaptive/w16_3_7_15_c.json
only by the opt-in confidence policy: SGLANG_ADAPTIVE_POLICY=confidence with the donor's
fitted step costs SGLANG_ADAPTIVE_STEP_A=7.943 SGLANG_ADAPTIVE_STEP_B=0.5554. Those are
fitted cost estimates, not measured guarantees. Without the env flag the slot is the
shipped acceptance EMA and the confidence keys it does not read are inert.
